mapper.select: select b.borrow_id, b.store_id, b.borrow_no, b.member_id, b.member_no, b.member_name, b.level_id, b.book_id, b.isbn, b.title, b.bar_code, b.location_id, b.deposit_amount, b.borrow_time, b.due_time, b.return_time, b.renew_count, b.is_overdue, b.overdue_days, b.fine_amount, b.fine_paid, b.is_compensated, b.status, b.operator_by, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from biz_borrow b where b.status in (1, 3) and b.return_time is null and (b.bar_code = #{code} or b.isbn = #{code}) order by b.borrow_id desc limit 1

select date_format(b.borrow_time,
'%Y-%m' '%x-W%v' '%Y-%m-%d' ) as label, count(*) as lendCount, sum(case when b.return_time is not null then 1 else 0 end) as returnCount from biz_borrow b where b.borrow_time >= #{from} and b.borrow_time <= #{to} group by label order by label

select case when datediff(b.return_time, b.borrow_time) <= 7 then '0-7' when datediff(b.return_time, b.borrow_time) <= 14 then '8-14' when datediff(b.return_time, b.borrow_time) <= 21 then '15-21' when datediff(b.return_time, b.borrow_time) <= 30 then '22-30' else '30+' end as label, count(*) as cnt from biz_borrow b where b.return_time is not null and b.return_time >= #{from} and b.return_time <= #{to} group by label

select b.level_id as levelId, l.level_name as levelName, count(*) as lendCount from biz_borrow b left join biz_member_level l on l.level_id = b.level_id where b.borrow_time >= #{from} and b.borrow_time <= #{to} group by b.level_id, l.level_name order by lendCount desc

select count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when b.is_overdue = 1 or (b.return_time is null and b.due_time < #{to}) then 1 else 0 end) as overdueCount from biz_borrow b where b.borrow_time >= #{from} and b.borrow_time <= #{to}
select count(*) from biz_borrow b where b.member_id = #{memberId} and b.status in (1, 3)
select count(*) from biz_borrow_reserve r where r.book_id = #{bookId} and r.status in (1, 2)
